name: Adslastica
author: hockyfan

sections.description:
Adslastica is a lightweight WordPress plugin that helps you manually place Google AdSense ads using shortcodes.

The plugin helps users manually control homepage ads placement and keep layouts cleaner compared to automatic ads.

For best results, you can exclude your homepage from Auto Ads inside your Google AdSense account and manually place ads where you want using shortcodes.

Features:

  • Add your Google AdSense Publisher ID
  • Manually place ads using shortcodes
  • Keep homepage layouts cleaner
  • Simple and beginner-friendly interface
  • Lightweight and easy to use
  • Works with most modern WordPress themes and page builders
  • Supports AdSense manual homepage placements

Shortcodes:

  • Ad 1: [adslastica_ad_1]
  • Ad 2: [adslastica_ad_2]

External Services

This plugin connects to Google AdSense to load and display ads on your website.

It uses your AdSense Publisher ID to request ads from Google.

The following information may be sent to Google AdSense:

  • Publisher ID
  • Website URL and ad request information required by Google AdSense

This plugin does not collect personal user data.

Google AdSense:
https://www.google.com/adsense/

Google Privacy Policy:
https://policies.google.com/privacy

Google AdSense Terms:
https://www.google.com/adsense/terms/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress
  3. Open the Adslastica settings page
  4. Add your AdSense Publisher ID
  5. Paste your AdSense ad code into Ad 1 or Ad 2
  6. Use the shortcodes where you want the ads to appear
sections.faq:
How do I display ads?

Use these shortcodes:

  • [adslastica_ad_1]
  • [adslastica_ad_2]

You can place them inside posts, pages, widgets, or page builder blocks.

Does this plugin support homepage manual ads?

Yes. The plugin is designed to help users manually control homepage ad placement.

Does it work with Astra or other themes?

Yes. The plugin works with most modern WordPress themes and builders that support shortcodes.
